einzeiler: Sonos CEO Tom Conrad on fixing the app crisis and turning the speaker maker into a…
kurzfassung: Sonos CEO Tom Conrad reflects on the disastrous app redesign that sparked a leadership shakeup and how he took the helm to fix operations. He explains the company's shift toward treating hardware and software as a single cohesive system. The episode covers the launch of Sonos 27, new hardware products, AI integrations, and the challenges of smart home standards.
stichpunkte: Tom Conrad stepped in as interim CEO in January 2025 following the disastrous 2024 app redesign before taking the permanent role.
The company restructured from a divisional model into a functional organization to align hardware and software teams more effectively.
Sonos abandoned its plans to build a set-top box to refocus resources on audio and core system capabilities.
The newly announced software platform, Sonos 27, unifies the ecosystem with a naming convention tied to yearly updates.
Sonos introduced new hardware including the Beam Ultra soundbar and the Ace Ultra headphones.
Sonos 27 introduces MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration, allowing external AI agents to connect to the Sonos system.
The platform features an updated voice assistant and a custom agents capability to run multiple AI inference models.
The new Ace Ultra headphones feature Headphone Engine 2, enabling seamless audio handoff from room speakers without Bluetooth.

clips.hook: Treating every device as an isolated product created unintended consequences.
clips.text: The previous strategy of focusing heavily on individual hardware products caused the company to overlook how each device functioned as part of the broader system.
The organization currently employs approximately 1,500 people.

clips.hook: The software platform finally has a name: Sonos 27.
clips.text: For two decades, hardware products received individual names while the underlying software platform remained unnamed until now.

clips.hook: Build custom AI personalities to live inside your speakers.
clips.text: Users can set up specialized agents powered by different language models, assigning them distinct voices, names, and conversational topics.

clips.hook: Jump music from a room speaker to your headphones without Bluetooth.
clips.text: Users can press a button on the new headphones near any playing speaker to instantly transfer the audio stream without relying on a phone or wireless pairing.

beschreibung:
My guest today is Sonos CEO Tom Conrad. Tom was on the board at Sonos during the disastrous 2024 app redesign that threatened to crash the entire brand, and he took over as interim CEO to right the ship during that period. About a year ago, he took the permanent role.

I have been dying to have Tom on the show to talk about how the board decided to move on from previous CEO Patrick Spence, how he diagnosed the issues inside the company, and what decisions he made to fix them. Plus. Tom was willing to get into the weeds and nerd out with me, and I think this one is pretty fun because of it.

Read the full interview transcript on The Verge.
